Prepare a chart configuration from a dataframe

prep_chart.Rd

Takes a dataframe in wide or long format and prepares a chart configuration object that can be passed to view_chart, save_chart, or get_code.

Usage

prep_chart(
  data,
  type = "line",
  title = NULL,
  y_axis = NULL,
  legend = NULL,
  colours = NULL,
  dashed = NULL,
  dotted = NULL,
  xmin = NULL,
  xmax = NULL,
  stacked = FALSE,
  emphasis = NULL,
  legend_columns = 2,
  rolling = NULL,
  growth = NULL,
  index = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  note = NULL,
  forecast = NULL,
  language = "si",
  axis = NULL,
  y_axis2 = NULL,
  ylim2 = NULL,
  y_ref = NULL,
  y_ref2 = NULL,
  vline = NULL
)

Arguments

data

dataframe in wide or long format

type

character, either a single value applied to all series or a vector of per-series values. Valid: "line", "bar" or "area" (for max 2 series). Defaults to "line".

title

character, chart title. Defaults to NULL (no title).

y_axis

character, y-axis label. Defaults to NULL.

legend

character vector of legend labels. Defaults to column names (wide) or unique group values (long).

colours

integer vector (indices into UMAR palette) or character vector (hex colours). Defaults to sequential palette colours.

dashed

integer vector for which series should be drawn dashed

dotted

integer vector for which series should be drawn dotted

xmin

Date or character coercible to Date. Left x-axis limit.

xmax

Date or character coercible to Date. Right x-axis limit.

stacked

logical, stack bar series. Defaults to FALSE.

emphasis

numeric value(s) for emphasised horizontal gridlines. NULL (default) auto-detects: 0 if in range, 100 if y_axis contains "indeks"/"index". FALSE disables. Numeric vector for explicit values. On a dual-axis chart these are read against the left axis.

legend_columns

integer, number of columns in the legend. Defaults to 2.

rolling

number of periods to calculate rolling mean over

growth

"YOY", "MOM" or "QOQ"

index

base_period either a year in YYYY format or quarter in 2023Q2 format or month in 2023M03 format

ylim

numeric(2) manual y-axis limits, e.g. c(90, 120). NULL (default) auto-detects. Ignored for bar charts (must include 0).

note

character string, possibly with \n breaks

forecast

character or date vector of lenght 2 to determine extend of gray background shading.

language

language option "si" or "en", defaulting to the former

axis

integer vector assigning series to the left (1) or right (2) y axis. Length 1 or one per series. Defaults to all on the left.

y_axis2

character, right y-axis label. Only used when some series are on axis 2.

ylim2

numeric(2) manual limits for the right axis. NULL (default) derives them from the data, paired with the left axis so that the gridlines serve both.

y_ref

reference for pairing y-axis

y_ref2

reference for pairing y-axis

vline

location of vertical line(s)

Value

An object of class "umar_chart" containing the data and config.

Details

Wide format: first column is date (Date class), remaining columns are numeric series. Column names become legend labels by default.

Long format: exactly three columns — one Date, one numeric (values), one character or factor (series names) or multiple character or factor which get concatented into series names unless legend in given.
